messages:
Maria (CS): Quick: drafting a compact customer-facing runbook for accounts flagged as Renewal Risk. Goal = ensure demo-day reliability (no latency spikes), proactive enablement, and a tight feedback loop. I’ll list bullets, pls +1 or edit.

Jasper (Eng): +1. Keep it short for AMs. Core ops: warm caches, streaming fallback, and a one-click survey at demo end. Suggest a lightweight prefill job that runs ~30m before call. Example cURL to prefill KV cache (replace samples):
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/gpt-redwood-1/prefill" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompts": ["Summarize the user profile: Acme Corp, finance domain","Give 3 short examples of expected responses"], "mode": "kv_prefill"}'
```
Keep payload small (4–6 prompts). This warms token cache and warms kernels.

Sophie (PM): Add to AM checklist: 1) Confirm model version pinned in route (no unexpected rollouts). 2) Confirm streaming=true for demo channel. 3) Confirm prefill ran & last-run time shown in console. 4) Agree fallback policy (which model variant to use if heavy load). I'll draft a one-pager for AMs.

Noah (Support): For streaming fallbacks — prefer graceful degrade to chunked responses rather than full sync failure. Minimal config snippet we share with customers: 
```
fallback_policy: "graceful"
preferred_models: ["gpt-redwood-1","gpt-redwood-1-small"]
streaming_timeout_ms: 700
max_sync_latency_ms: 1200
```
If streaming times out, client should retry once with `streaming=false`. Add this to SDK quickstart.

oncall-bot: prefill-job acme-inc scheduled by @Maria (CS) to run at 2025-07-22T14:30:00Z :white_check_mark:

Maria (CS): AM-facing one-click steps (short):
- Run prefill (button in console) or use the cURL above.
- Verify pinned model + streaming enabled.
- Toggle burst capacity if expecting >1 concurrent demo.
- Start demo, monitor console for latency spikes (token-level view).
- If spike: switch to fallback model variant, then re-run prefill between demos.

Sophie (PM): For feedback capture: send 2-question survey at end: (1) Was response latency acceptable? (Yes/No) (2) Anything confusing in outputs? (free text). Make it ~15s. Use `/send-survey <acct> demo-eval` to trigger. Recommend adding NPS field if high-risk renewal.

Jasper (Eng): Ops tip: schedule lightweight synthetic traffic for 5–10 min before demo to prime batching heuristics (use small batch of 2–4 requests, sequence lengths similar to live demo). Script snippet: 
```
for i in 1..10; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"<demo query>","stream":false}' &
done
```
This helps the serving runtime choose stable kernels and warms batching groups.

Noah (Support): Capture customer feedback into ticket: tag with `renewal-risk` and include `prefill_last_run`, `model_pinned`, and `latency_samples` from console export. Template for AM handoff in ticket: 
- Preflight runbook completed: yes/no
- Prefill timestamp: 
- Model pinned: 
- Streaming enabled: 
- Demo notes / customer comments: 

Maria (CS): Perfect. I'll convert this into a one-pager + a small checklist card AMs can run from the console. Leaving final tweaks to PM/Eng. Thanks! :pray:

Sophie (PM): Will add the one-click survey + a tiny SDK example for retry logic. Will ping for review tomorrow. :rocket:
